settings.question: How do Lunelle's wire-free designs provide gentle support?
settings.answer: Lunelle designs lingerie that honors a woman's natural silhouette. Instead of rigid underwires that pinch or restrict, we utilize precision anatomical cuts, supportive underband tension, and premium double-lined fabrics that provide tender, uplifted structure with zero pressure points.

settings.question: What is the recommended Care Ritual for delicate intimate garments?
settings.answer: To preserve the delicate luster, elasticity, and softness of your pieces: hand wash gently in cool water using mild pH-neutral detergent. Avoid harsh wringing or machine spin drying. Gently press between a soft towel to remove excess moisture and line dry flat in the shade away from direct sunlight.

settings.question: Where do you ship and what are the delivery timeframes?
settings.answer: We deliver nationwide across the Philippines. Metro Manila orders typically arrive within 2 to 4 business days. Provincial areas in Luzon, Visayas, and Mindanao arrive within 4 to 7 business days via our designated courier partners (EasyShip / J&T / LBC). All orders are accompanied by real-time tracking updates.

settings.question: Is domestic shipping complimentary?
settings.answer: Yes. All domestic orders with a subtotal of ₱3,500.00 PHP or higher automatically qualify for complimentary domestic delivery applied directly at checkout.

settings.question: What is the return and hygiene policy for intimate apparel?
settings.answer: Under Philippine consumer protection and sanitary guidelines (RA 7394), intimate undergarments worn directly against delicate skin cannot be returned once tried on, washed, or unsealed. We provide a 7-calendar-day inspection window from delivery receipt for any verified manufacturing flaws or dispatch discrepancies. Approved returns receive a 1-to-1 replacement or Store Credit valid for 12 months.

settings.question: How will my order be packaged? Can I include a gift message?
settings.answer: Every Lunelle order is packaged as an intimate gift to yourself. Garments are wrapped in soft tissue paper and housed in a discreet, elegant exterior box. During checkout, you can add a whisper gift note that will be printed on our signature cardstock.
